Brand Introduction

Gravity Caddy is a premier provider of innovative golf accessories, specializing in high-quality automatic golf ball dispensers. Our mission is to enhance the golfing experience with products that combine convenience, reliability, and cutting-edge technology.

Product Description

The Gravity Caddy is an automatic golf ball dispenser designed to streamline your golfing experience. Unlike traditional dispensers that rely on batteries, electricity, or pedals, our dispenser operates purely on the force of gravity. The device senses the weight difference when a golf ball is placed on the tee and when it is hit, triggering the next ball to be dispensed seamlessly. This eliminates interruptions in your game and ensures a smooth and uninterrupted golfing session.

USP (Unique Selling Point)

  • No Battery or Electricity Required: Operates solely on gravity, making it eco-friendly and maintenance-free.
  • Seamless Dispensing Mechanism: Automatically dispenses a new golf ball as soon as the previous one is hit, ensuring a continuous and efficient game.
  • Premium Build Quality: Designed with high-quality materials for durability and long-lasting performance.
  • Convenient and Easy to Use: Simple setup and operation, enhancing your golfing experience without complex mechanisms.

Payment Terms

  • Commission Rate: Earn between 10 - 15% of Commission on every sale! 
  • Payment Schedule: Payments are process monthly, with minimum payout threshold of $50
  • Minimum Payout Threshold: Minimum payout threshold of $50 
  • Tracking and Report: Affiliates have access to a robust tracking and reporting system to monitor their sales and commissions in real-time 

Other Information

  • Promotional Materials: Affiliates will have access to a range of promotional materials, including banners, product images, and pre-written contents to help them with effectively promote Gravity Caddy. 
  • Dedicated Support: Our affilate team is available to provide support and answer any questsions affiliates may have. 
  • Exclusive Offers: Affilates will be given access to exclusive discounts and promotions to share with their audience, enhancing their ability to drive sales. 
  • Easy Sign Up: Our affiliate program features a straightforward signup process, making it easy for interested parties to join and start earning. 

By joining the Gravity Caddy affiliate program, affiliates have the opportunity to partner with with a fun and innovative brand, offering products that enhances their golf experience that is new to North America. 

If you need any more specific details or further assistance, feel freek to ask!
